newsitem.title: UK: UK welcomes halt to E Jerusalem Jewish enclave.
newsitem.headline: UK welcomes halt to E Jerusalem Jewish enclave.

text.p: Britain said on Monday it hoped Israel's decision to halt construction of a new Jewish enclave in Arab East Jerusalem was a sign of more flexibility to come.

Israel's interior ministry suspended a permit granted to a Jewish-American land baron to build 70 Jewish homes in Ras al-Amoud, a neighbourhood of 11,000 Arabs on the slopes of the Mount of Olives, until an appeal against the plan has been heard.

The Foreign Office, welcoming the decision, said it hoped the temporary suspension would be made permanent pending the outcome of negotiations of the final status of Jerusalem as part of the Middle East peace process.
"We also hope that the Israeli government will show similar flexibility on settlement building elsewhere," the ministry said in a statement.
